steps.en: Foreign driver details are entered with a FIN
steps.id: Data driver asing diisi dengan nomor FIN

steps.en: Page checks the FIN work pass status live
steps.id: Halaman mengecek status work pass FIN secara live
steps.why_en: No live work pass check exists in the portal.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya pengecekan live status work pass.

steps.en: Page shows a message that the work pass expired
steps.id: Halaman menampilkan pesan work pass kedaluwarsa
steps.why_en: No expired work pass message exists in the portal.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya pesan work pass kedaluwarsa.

steps.en: Page lets the user choose to continue or pay
steps.id: Halaman memberi pilihan lanjut atau bayar
steps.why_en: Only generic pay and continue buttons exist; no choice tied to the expired work pass.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada tombol bayar dan lanjut umum; tidak ada pilihan terkait work pass kedaluwarsa.
